handoff: Approve: every criterion is proven by a test I read and ran (core 4/4, cli integration 5/5), and the slice adds tests only, as D10 says. One minor note: the AC2 and story 22 example (2/3) should read (3/3).

findings.title: AC2 and user story 22 give `(2/3)` as the warning text, but the warning reads `(3/3)`
findings.detail:
AC2 says: 'Given that counter at 2 of 3, when the brief for the next implement step is built, then it warns `Last round on review.changes_requested (2/3)`'. The next implement step only starts after one more send-back, and that send-back brings the counter to 3. brief.ts:304 warns when value >= max, so the warning shows the current value: (3/3), where one more send-back exhausts the counter. The test asserts that. It is the same rule for named counters, so the spec example is the thing that is off, not the code.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: When the docs slice or the person next edits the spec, change the example in AC2 and user story 22 to `(3/3)`. Leave the code as it is.
